name: Ricardo Benavides
bio:
Ricardo Benavides' journey into motorsport began in the dusty karting tracks of Buenos Aires, where he honed his skills as a mechanic before transitioning to team management. His keen eye for detail and ability to motivate his crew quickly gained him recognition. Prior to joining Ipiranga Racing, Ricardo spent a decade managing smaller regional racing outfits, consistently exceeding expectations with limited resources. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where innovation is encouraged, and every team member understands their role in achieving victory. Ricardo's distinctive approach lies in his ability to blend traditional motorsport values with modern technological advancements, creating a competitive edge for his team.

Ricardo is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to make strategic decisions in the heat of the moment. He's a firm believer in data analysis but also trusts his gut instinct, a quality honed through years of experience in the racing world. He emphasizes the importance of team cohesion and open communication, fostering a culture where individuals feel empowered to contribute their best.

His commitment to nurturing young talent and pushing the boundaries of motorsport technology sets him apart as a leader with a long-term vision. Ricardo's ultimate goal is not just to win races but to build a legacy of excellence and innovation at Ipiranga Racing.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a stern but approachable face, Ricardo carries himself with quiet confidence.
